control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems
dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy

facts.title: loss of containment at PSV-8210 during a planned shutdown

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices had degraded below its design intent, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.
Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-8210 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-8210 (steam relief devices) is in service for boiler and deaerator overpressure protection. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 2 August 2005 an incident occurred on PSV-8210 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during a planned shutdown, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
